source.text_it: La ruota di scorta fa parte dei dispositivi obbligatori di un autoveicolo

records.localized_text: A spare wheel is mandatory equipment on a motor vehicle.

source.text_it: Un veicolo industriale di massa complessiva a pieno carico superiore a 18 tonnellate non rischia di subire il fenomeno dell'aquaplaning, perché è troppo pesante perché ciò accada

records.localized_text: An industrial vehicle with total laden mass over 18 tonnes cannot aquaplane because it is too heavy.

source.text_it: L'indicazione M & S indica uno pneumatico fabbricato nel Regno Unito

records.localized_text: M & S indicates a tire made in the United Kingdom.

source.text_it: Gli pneumatici radiali sono più flessibili di quelli a tele incrociate

records.localized_text: Radial tires are more flexible than cross-ply tires.

source.text_it: Uno pneumatico tubeless è sprovvisto di camera d’aria

records.localized_text: A tubeless tire has no inner tube.

source.text_it: Gli pneumatici gemellati devono essere simmetrici, per dimensione e disegno, rispetto all’asse di marcia

records.localized_text: Dual tires must be symmetrical in size and pattern relative to the direction of travel.

source.text_it: Gli pneumatici radiali sono più resistenti di quelli tradizionali

records.localized_text: Radial tires are more resistant than conventional tires.

source.text_it: Gli pneumatici radiali sono obbligatori per l’equipaggiamento di un mezzo d’opera

records.localized_text: Construction vehicles must be fitted with radial tires.

source.text_it: Uno pneumatico tubeless deve essere gonfiato ad una pressione maggiore rispetto a uno con camera d’aria

records.localized_text: A tubeless tire must be inflated to a higher pressure than an inner-tube tire.

source.text_it: Uno pneumatico tubeless ha una minore tenuta di strada rispetto a uno con camera d’aria

records.localized_text: A tubeless tire has poorer road holding than an inner-tube tire.

source.text_it: Gli pneumatici gemellati che presentano zone di consumo sui fianchi interni non sono pericolosi perché il fatto è dovuto a normale usura da contatto

records.localized_text: Dual tires with worn inner sidewalls are not dangerous because contact wear is normal.

source.text_it: La corretta pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici è fondamentale per il confort di marcia

records.localized_text: Correct tire pressure is essential for ride comfort.

source.text_it: La corretta pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici è fondamentale per la tenuta di strada del veicolo

records.localized_text: Correct tire pressure is essential for road holding.

source.text_it: La corretta pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici è fondamentale per la stabilità del veicolo

records.localized_text: Correct tire pressure is essential for vehicle stability.

source.text_it: La pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici deve essere adeguata al carico del veicolo

records.localized_text: Tire pressure must suit the vehicle's load.

source.text_it: La corretta pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici è fondamentale per la durata dello pneumatico

records.localized_text: Correct tire pressure is essential for tire life.

source.text_it: La corretta pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici garantisce la giusta area di impronta del battistrada

records.localized_text: Correct tire pressure ensures the proper tread contact area.

source.text_it: La corretta pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici comporta migliore confort, ma maggior consumo di carburante

records.localized_text: Correct tire pressure improves comfort but increases fuel consumption.

source.text_it: Se si prevede di dover percorrere lunghe discese, occorre abbassare la pressione degli pneumatici di mezzo Bar

records.localized_text: Before long descents, tire pressure must be reduced by half a bar.

source.text_it: La corretta pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici è fondamentale solo nei mesi estivi

records.localized_text: Correct tire pressure is essential only in summer.

source.text_it: Il valore della corretta pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici è indicato sul fianco dello pneumatico

records.localized_text: Correct tire pressure is shown on the tire sidewall.

source.text_it: La corretta pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici è fondamentale solo a veicolo a pieno carico

records.localized_text: Correct tire pressure is essential only when the vehicle is fully loaded.

source.text_it: La corretta pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici deve essere annotata sulla carta di circolazione

records.localized_text: Correct tire pressure must be recorded on the registration document.

source.text_it: La pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici deve essere misurata a pneumatico freddo

records.localized_text: Tire pressure must be measured when the tire is cold.

source.text_it: Alla fine di un viaggio, uno pneumatico troppo gonfio ha il battistrada più caldo al centro

records.localized_text: At the end of a journey, an overinflated tire's tread is hottest in the center.

rows.text: A spare wheel is not generally required: fitted tyres or equivalent systems are compulsory, not an additional wheel.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-72/ — Codice della strada, art. 72, commi 1 e 2: elenca pneumatici o sistemi equivalenti e gli altri dispositivi obbligatori, senza imporre una ruota di scorta.

rows.text: Even a heavy vehicle can lose contact with the road if water builds up beneath its tyres. Weight does not eliminate the risk of aquaplaning.
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/aquaplaning/ — Aquaplaning: il velo d’acqua separa pneumatico e strada; neppure i veicoli più pesanti sono immuni.

rows.text: M & S identifies a tyre intended to improve traction in mud and snow, not its country of manufacture.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A42011X1123%2803%29 — Regolamento UNECE 117, punto 4.2.6: marcatura M&S per prestazioni su fango e neve fresca o in scioglimento.

rows.text: Radial tyres have more flexible sidewalls, which work more independently from the tread than in cross-ply construction.
evidence: Michelin, Radial tyres, https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/by-technology/radial — radial construction and more flexible sidewalls; Firestone, agricultural construction, https://commercial.bridgestone.com/en-us/resource-center/articles/tire-construction — radial sidewall movement more independent of tread than crossed-ply design; agricultural example.

rows.text: Tubeless means the tyre is designed to retain air without an inner tube.
evidence: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/advice/tyre-basics/tyre-markings-explained — How to identify the type of tyre: tubeless non richiede una camera d’aria.

rows.text: Dual tyres should be matched and arranged evenly on both sides: compatible sizes and the same tread pattern on the axle help distribute the load and maintain consistent handling.
evidence: USTMA, Care and Service of Commercial Truck and Bus Tires (2017), printed p. 51 (PDF p.55), https://www.ustires.org/sites/default/files/2024-08/Care%20and%20Service%20of%20Commercial%20Truck%20and%20Bus%20Tires%202017%20.pdf — retread matching for dual assemblies, diameter difference causes uneven loading; ideal same tread design across axle, with qualified exceptions.
Michelin, truck tyre use in Italy, https://professional.michelin.it/aiuto-consigli/uso-in-italia — identical tread on same axle recommended.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE, but does not say what kind of resistance it means. Radial tyres have plies running across the tyre and a belt stabilizing the tread; bias-ply tyres have crossed plies. Resistance depends on the damage, design and use: for example, Michelin describes radial tyres as more resistant to damage and heat than bias tyres.
evidence: Official superiori source page 127, 30118, printed FALSO: resistance is unqualified; adjacent 30115 concerns flexibility and does not define the intended metric. No official explanation of intended meaning verified.

Michelin, Radial tyres, https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/by-technology/radial — construction and manufacturer claim of stronger radial casing resisting damage, punctures and heat relative to bias tyres; manufacturer comparison does not guarantee superiority for every design or application.

Firestone Commercial, agricultural tire construction, https://commercial.bridgestone.com/en-us/resource-center/articles/tire-construction — agricultural bias examples prioritize sidewall puncture/cut protection while radial examples cite resistance to tread cuts/punctures and cooler operation; application-specific manufacturer examples, not a universal road-tyre ranking.

rows.text: A construction vehicle does not by definition require radial tyres: choose tyres approved and suitable for the vehicle and its use.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A42021X1366 — Regolamento ONU 142, punti 2.1 e 5: tipi, dimensioni e capacità adatti al veicolo; https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?qid=1788304039898&uri=CELEX%3A02008X0711%2801%29-20100317 — Regolamento ONU 54, punti 1 e 2.3: pneumatici commerciali sia radiali sia diagonali.

rows.text: Pressure is not automatically higher because a tyre is tubeless. Use the pressure specified for the tyre, load and operating conditions.
evidence: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — The right pressure: pressione adeguata in funzione di carico e condizioni; https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/advice/tyre-basics/tyre-markings-explained — Tubeless indica assenza della camera.

rows.text: Tubeless describes the absence of an inner tube and does not imply poorer road holding. Grip depends on the tyre’s characteristics and condition, including its pressure.
evidence: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/advice/tyre-basics/tyre-markings-explained — Tubeless non richiede camera; https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/tire-pressure/ — La pressione influisce su aderenza e comportamento.

rows.text: Rub marks on the inner sidewalls should not be dismissed as harmless wear: contact caused by underinflation or incorrect fitting can damage dual tyres and needs checking.
evidence: Northern Ireland Department for Infrastructure, Tyres, https://www.infrastructure-ni.gov.uk/articles/tyres — sidewalls contacting due to underinflation or incorrect mounting are a major defect.

rows.text: Correct pressure allows the tyre to absorb road irregularities as intended. Excessive pressure can make the ride harsher.
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/tire-pressure/ — Tire pressure: la pressione raccomandata bilancia sicurezza e comfort; sovragonfiaggio rende la marcia più rigida.

rows.text: Pressure affects the contact area and the tyre’s behaviour: keeping it correct helps road holding.
evidence: https://professional.michelin.it/help-advice/truck/tyre-pressure-is-essential — Pressione inadeguata riduce aderenza e stabilità; https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/tire-pressure/ — Pressione e contatto con la strada.

rows.text: Underinflation changes the tyre’s behaviour and can reduce vehicle stability. Maintain the pressure specified for the load.
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/b2b/truck/generation-5/continental-whitepaper-tires.pdf.coredownload.pdf — The Importance of Tire Pressure: sottogonfiaggio riduce la stabilità dinamica; https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressione e carico.

rows.text: Choose the pressure according to the load and the manufacturer’s instructions: an underinflated tyre deforms excessively under load.
evidence: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressione appropriata al carico e alle condizioni; https://metro.michelin.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/10/Guide-PMR-20000_en.pdf — Deflection: eccessiva deformazione con sottogonfiaggio o sovraccarico.

rows.text: Incorrect pressure increases wear and can damage the structure. Maintaining the specified pressure helps extend tyre life.
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/b2b/truck/generation-5/continental-whitepaper-tires.pdf.coredownload.pdf — The Importance of Tire Pressure: sottogonfiaggio aumenta usura e rischio di danni.

rows.text: Correct pressure helps the tread maintain its intended contact patch with the road. Incorrect pressure changes its shape and contact distribution.
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/tire-pressure/ — Tire pressure: la pressione modifica il contatto con la strada e l’usura; https://www.mdpi.com/2073-4433/17/10/1011 — pressione e distribuzione della pressione nell’impronta.

rows.text: The specified pressure supports comfort and efficiency; it does not necessarily increase fuel consumption. Underinflation increases rolling resistance and therefore fuel use.
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/b2b/truck/generation-5/continental-whitepaper-tires.pdf.coredownload.pdf — sottogonfiaggio aumenta resistenza e consumo; https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/tire-pressure/ — pressione prescritta e comfort.

rows.text: Do not let half a bar out of the tyres for a descent. Maintain the prescribed cold pressure for the load and use.
evidence: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressione determinata da carico e condizioni; https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/b2b/truck/generation-5/continental-whitepaper-tires.pdf.coredownload.pdf — valori applicati a pneumatici freddi.

rows.text: Correct pressure matters all year, not only in summer: incorrect pressure impairs tyre performance and life.
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/b2b/truck/generation-5/continental-whitepaper-tires.pdf.coredownload.pdf — controlli regolari e conseguenze del sottogonfiaggio su stabilità e usura.

rows.text: Find the operating pressure in the vehicle or tyre manufacturer’s instructions for the load. A sidewall value may be a maximum, not the pressure specified for that vehicle.
evidence: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/advice/tyre-basics/tyre-markings-explained — MAX PRESS sul fianco non è necessariamente la pressione del veicolo; consultare le indicazioni del costruttore.

rows.text: Pressure must also be correct at partial load: use the value specified for the actual load and operating conditions.
evidence: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressione adeguata al carico e alle condizioni, non solo a pieno carico.

rows.text: The correct pressure comes from the manufacturer’s instructions for the vehicle, tyres and load; it need not be entered on the registration certificate.
evidence: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/advice/tyre-basics/tyre-markings-explained — valori raccomandati nel manuale o sull’etichetta; https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — scelta in funzione del carico.

rows.text: Check pressure when the tyre is cold because driving heats it and raises the pressure, changing the reading relative to the specified value.
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/b2b/truck/generation-5/continental-whitepaper-tires.pdf.coredownload.pdf — Get it right: i valori si riferiscono a gomme fredde; la pressione aumenta durante il riscaldamento.

rows.text: With excessive inflation, contact tends to concentrate in the centre of the tread, which can become hotter than the edges during driving.
evidence: https://researchcommons.waikato.ac.nz/server/api/core/bitstreams/ed1d9813-eac5-4589-ba1b-7c063f4adc71/content — University of Waikato, tyre contact patch, printed pp. 17–18 (PDF pp. 30–31): nel modello illustrato la pressione eccessiva concentra il contatto e il calore al centro; analisi nel contesto di pneumatici da competizione, tendenza non diagnosi universale.
https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/tire-pressure/ — il sovragonfiaggio favorisce l’usura centrale.

issues.reason: Il quesito indica FALSO per la maggiore resistenza dei radiali senza specificare a quale sollecitazione si riferisca. Una fonte tecnica del costruttore attribuisce ai radiali maggiore resistenza a danni, forature e calore rispetto ai diagonali; la formulazione generica non permette di individuare con certezza il senso che renderebbe falso il confronto senza aggiungere una limitazione non dichiarata.

https://business.michelin.co.uk/by-technology/radial — Resistance to damage: descrive maggiore resistenza dei radiali a danni, forature e calore rispetto ai diagonali.

https://www.michelinb2b.com/wps/b2bcontent/PDF/TECHNICAL_Usage_and_Maintenance_Guide.pdf — Comparing tire construction, p. 11: corona radiale rinforzata con migliore resistenza a danni e forature, fianchi flessibili.
